create_base_options_instance: create a BaseOptions instance to initialize argparse-based command-line argument parsing
initialize_argument_parser: initialize the BaseOptions argument parser with dataset, GPU, batch size, and audio/video parameters
parse_command_line_args: parse command-line arguments and return a namespace object with processed GPU IDs and options
configure_gpu_device: configure CUDA device selection from comma-separated GPU IDs passed via command-line arguments
save_options_to_disk: save parsed command-line options to a text file in the experiment checkpoint directory
